title: Dual fixing
heading: A Variable That Only Helps Is Set to Its Best Value
cases: a variable with positive value and no row entries is fixed at 1
a variable whose only entry is -1 in a precedence row is fixed at 1 when its value is positive
a variable with negative value and only positive entries is fixed at 0
one positive entry in any row keeps a valuable variable free, even if another of its entries is negative
a variable worth exactly 0 is fixed at 1 when none of its entries is positive, and left free otherwise
